items: Privacy: sharing your location with a friend is now off by default. When you add a friend, RigRoute asks “Share my location with them?” and nothing is sent until you tap Yes. Choices you already made stay the same.
Tap any icon on the map, like a red 🚘, to see what it is (for example Broken-down vehicle), who reported it and how long ago. A new Map key button in More lists every icon.
The phone Back button now closes the open sheet or panel instead of leaving the app.
Fixes: works better offline on iPhone, Arabic and Hebrew text reads the right way, and tapping Send twice sends only once. More of the app is in Spanish.
If you try to vote twice on a pin, or on your own pin, RigRoute now tells you instead of saying thanks.
Tap a hazard pin and choose 👍 Still there or 👎 Not there, no account needed. Pins marked gone by two drivers disappear. Ask RigRoute now knows how to use every part of the app, like adding a stop.

Fixed: HOS buttons now light up the status you tap right away. Fixed: the Multi-stop sheet lines up on iPhone, and the hint matches the Best order button. Your destination stays after a reload. Bigger buttons, and nothing on the map covers the controls.
Hazards you report are shared with every driver again, no account needed. Pins clear themselves after a few hours (a day for closures). Ask RigRoute only counts answers it actually gives.
No account needed, ever: sign-up and sign-in are gone. Everything works right away and your settings stay on this phone. Report a Bug, Ask RigRoute and What's New all work without signing in.
Ask RigRoute can now answer with an AI helper when it is turned on. If the AI is off or busy, it answers from the built-in help. While you drive, answers are read out loud only.
Sign in without a password: get a code by email. Google sign-in shows up as soon as it is turned on.
Truck routes on local streets: long rigs get wider streets with fewer tight turns, and in New York City routes stick to the official truck routes.
Faster route offers: when traffic builds up, RigRoute tells you about a faster truck-safe road. Tap Switch to take it or Keep to stay. It never changes your route by itself.
Fixed a crash when opening Me before the app finished loading.
New tour in plain words. Tap ? and then Show me around to see every part of the app.
Report a Bug / Suggestion in Me, with an Email us button.
Help RigRoute grow (off unless you turn it on): share only your city and state so we can bring help to drivers near you.
Ask RigRoute: type a question in Help and get an answer about the app.
